Check your download

Use the checksum supplied with the exact release when available. On Windows, run Get-FileHash 'C:\path\download.zip' -Algorithm SHA256 and compare it with the publisher’s checksum. A matching hash checks file integrity; it does not establish executable signing or guarantee safety.
